explanation: Merges main (#101). From main: externalReference, regionalSummary, portalCards, deployGuards, sourceJson and expressionSurvey tests cover the Visium provider, its tile, transport allow-list and source_credit CSV column. From this branch: the HypoMap fixture writes every study-card column (blank as an empty string); the atlas client tests cover named study fields, a partial card whose non-http link and non-numeric cell count read as null, a blank card and the Publication and Technology CSV columns; the preview tests read a checked dataset's linked publication and facts, and a blank card shows no details.
